title: Decret n° 2022-698 du 7 decembre 2022 fixant les modalites d'enregistrement des projets carbone en Republique du Benin
citation: Decret n° 2022-698 du 07 decembre 2022 (Presidency of the Republic)
evidence: Art. 11: "Le present decret, qui prend effet pour compter de sa date de signature, sera publie au Journal officiel." Signed at Cotonou, 07 decembre 2022. Read on page 11 of https://sgg.gouv.bj/doc/decret-2022-698/download on 2026-11-03.
notes: Duty on project promoters (Art. 3) to register carbon projects with the registration authority. Implemented through the authority created by bj-aepc-decree. Link only: the PDF served at the official URL is a scan (200, 2289098 bytes, application/pdf) with no text layer (pdftotext returns nothing), so no text is stored. The page was read as page images on 2026-11-03. No government English translation was found: the sgg.gouv.bj site and its documentheque are French only and list no translation. French is the only official language of legislation.

title: Loi n° 2026-15 du 23 juillet 2026 portant loi sur l'environnement en Republique du Benin
evidence: Art. 138: "La presente loi, qui abroge toutes dispositions anterieures contraires, notamment celles de la loi n° 98-030 du 12 fevrier 1999 portant loi-cadre sur l'environnement en Republique du Benin, sera executee comme Loi de l'Etat." Art. 137 gives a twelve-month compliance period "a compter de la date de sa promulgation". Fait a Cotonou, 23 juillet 2026. Read on pages 30 and 31 of https://sgg.gouv.bj/doc/loi-2026-15/download on 2026-11-03.
notes: New environment act, found on the sgg.gouv.bj home page; not in the brief. Replaces the 1999 framework act. in_force is null because the pages read state no commencement date (only the promulgation date, 2026-07-23). title: Loi n° 2007-21 du 16 octobre 2007 portant protection du consommateur en Republique du Benin
evidence: No commencement clause found; promulgated 16 octobre 2007 after the Constitutional Court decision DCC 07-109 of 11 octobre 2007.
notes: Umbrella consumer law. Art. 20: "Est interdite toute publicite comportant, sous quelque forme que ce soit, des allegations, indications ou presentations fausses ou de nature a induire en erreur." It does not mention environmental claims; it is the general misleading-advertising ban a green claim would fall under. in_force is null because no official page states a commencement date.
